description: Record a comment on an open deliberation, so the reasoning behind a vote survives alongside the tally. Comments carry no weight in the outcome and may be added by any participant at any point before chap.deliberate.close.

comment.description: The contribution to record. Comments are kept with the deliberation and in the audit log, so the reasoning survives the vote.

deliberation_id.description: Identifier returned by chap.deliberate.open. A closed deliberation is refused with -32032.

name: chap.deliberate.comment
title: Comment on deliberation
